property_summary: After a single play() call from a non-bank user with msg.value = 10, when random == 0, the reference updates pot to 10 before transfer, so the user receives pot - FEE_AMOUNT = 9, while the bug subtracts to -10 which underflows (revert on transfer), causing a revert difference.
change_summary: Replace the addition 'pot += msg.value' with subtraction 'pot -= msg.value'
